description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/lax_friedrichs_D_inflow_bc. Every binding loads fixture.esm (N bound to 8 at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: D(u, wrt: x) replaced by the rule's makearray flux-difference (interior [2,7] plus the i=1 inflow face with left ghost gL and the i=8 outflow face with extrapolated ghost u[8]), zero apply_expression_template nodes (the flux stencil inlined), zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, and zero surviving metaparameter names. Golden generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and byte-compared by the other bindings.
